svg.aria-label: AD-DEEN: Prayer Times, Waqt Alarms & Daily Amal Tracker in English and Bangla. Native Android app with high-precision prayer times for all 64 districts of Bangladesh, start and end alarms for every waqt, a 100-point daily amal tracker with streaks, and offline-first Firestore sync.

g.text: Prayer Times, Waqt Alarms & Daily Amal Tracker in English and
Native Android app with high-precision prayer times for all 64 districts of
Bangladesh, start and end alarms for every waqt, a 100-point daily amal
tracker with streaks, and offline-first Firestore sync.
Kotlin / Jetpack Compose / Material 3 / Room / Firebase
